value.rationale: The 2021 quandle derivation program leaves general modular dimensions open beyond small examples. This provides a complete natural operator-space classification, Lie-commutativity theorem, explicit arithmetic dimension and counting formula for every finite abelian odd-order quandle away from the group-order characteristic, and an infinite surprising characteristic-three family. The modular tangent phenomena are not recoverable from ordinary finite-field idempotent point counts. No arbitrary specialization or mere restatement is used.
